words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
